sentences: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award.
The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.
Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.
A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
translations: 一群工党议员，其中包括伊薇特·库珀，在新年之际呼吁设立英国“文化城镇”奖项。
该提议是，这一奖项应与现有的“文化城市”称号并列，该称号于2017年由赫尔获得，并已授予考文垂2021年。
库珀和她的同事们认为，赫尔获得这一桂冠的成功——它带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和大量的艺术活动——不应仅限于城市。
诚然，英国的城镇并非不能申请，但它们通常缺乏资源来组织一场竞标，以击败规模更大的竞争对手。
有人认为，“文化城镇”奖可以成为一年一度的盛事，吸引资金并创造就业机会。

sentences: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.

A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow—village of culture?
Suburb of culture?
Hamlet of culture?
translations: 有些人可能会将此提议视为一种安慰奖，因为英国不再能够申请更具声望的“欧洲文化之都”称号，这一备受追捧的奖项于1990年被格拉斯哥和2008年被利物浦获得。
愤世嫉俗者可能会推测，英国在脱欧后的世界中急于重塑自我，正处于陷入无休止自我庆祝狂热的边缘：在“文化城镇”之后，谁知道接下来会是什么——“文化村庄”？
“文化郊区”？
“文化小村”？

sentences: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.

But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
translations: 同样明智的是要记住，这样的称号并非万能灵药。
一个管理不善的“文化年”会像潮水一样涌来又退去，带来一时的关注，却不会给社区留下持久的利益。
真正成功获得此类称号的是那些做得远不止于填满酒店客房、在一年内引入高调艺术活动和良好媒体报道的地方。
它们改变了当地居民的愿望；它们将城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的方向。
这很难做好，需要非凡的远见，以及市政府、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的合作。
但这是可以做到的：格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年，无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一，这些因素使这座城市成为今天仍然是艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇的地方。

sentences: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.
translations: “文化城镇”不仅关乎艺术，还关乎尊重一个城镇的特色——帮助维持其商业街，支持当地设施，最重要的是颂扬其居民。
文化大臣杰里米·赖特应该欢迎这一积极、充满希望的提议，并将其付诸行动。

C. increase the economic strength of Britain's towns.
